leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a TypeScript interface to specify the shape of color data with hex and name properties
Construct a React functional component using TypeScript to serve as the main ColorPicker
Implement useState hook to manage the currently selected color state
Apply array iteration to map through a predefined color palette and render color options
Utilize event handlers to capture user clicks on color swatches
Execute conditional rendering to display the selected color's name and hex value
Control component styling by dynamically applying CSS classes based on selection state
Modify component props to accept an initial color value and customize the palette
Access DOM event properties to extract color data from clicked elements
Return JSX structure that includes interactive swatches, labels, and visual feedback
Store color data in a typed array constant to provide a reusable palette
Compare color values to determine active selection and update UI accordingly
